title: Account flight checklist — quick hits & QBR prep
content:
Purpose: 20–30min scratchpad to triage today's hành items for top accounts before dive meetings. Keep short, actionable. Timebox: 20m now, follow-up 40m later if needed.

Top account focus: NimbusHealth (renewal 2026-09-30) — usage trending up, one recent latency blip.

Immediate TODOs (today) — order of ops:
- Quick audit of last 7d latency by route (timebox 10m) — query Console per-route -> look for model fallback events. If >3 fallbacks, flag to SRE.
- Send short note to PM + SRE: ask for incident summary of 2026-08-23 03:40 UTC spike (obs: CPU hotspots on dedicated pool?). Draft: "Seen latency blips for NimbusHealth on 8/23 — can you confirm root cause and mitigation plan?"
- Renewal prep: update one-pager with actual token spend + projected next-12mo (use billing export CSV). Add line: "opportunity to save via Optimize: batching + prefix cache suggestion".
- QBR agenda stub (share with customer by Fri): 1) Key wins + usage trends 2) Reliability summary 3) Cost optimization opportunities 4) Roadmap alignment 5) Ask: renewal decision timeline.
- Schedule 30m pre-QBR with AE (Maya) next Tue 09:00-09:30 to align asks and credits.
- Support follow-ups: CS-4321 (embed sizing issue) — check if customer provided model inputs (they didn't). Send request for sample payloads + clarify peak windows.

Notes & hypotheses (raw):
- Hypothesis A: fallbacks due to autoscale coldstarts when burst > pool capacity. Solution: raise burst throttle for their dedicated pool or enable warm standby. Check dedicated config.
- Hypothesis B: tokenization causing longer sequences than expected -> cost spike. Ask for 1-2 sample transcripts.

Quick script / queries to run (placeholders):
- Console -> Metrics -> route:nimbus-generate latency p95 (7d)
- Billing export -> filter customer_id:nimbus -> sum tokens / avg per-call
- Logs -> filter for fallback reason: model_unavailable OR capacity_tripped

Messages to send (templates):
- To SRE: "Heads-up — NimbusHealth saw repeated fallback events on 8/23/2026. Can we get a short note on cause and next steps? Ticket CS-4321 attached."
- To Customer (quick check-in): "Hey team — prepping the QBR, quick ask: could you share 2 anonymized sample prompts & rough daily peak hour? That will help our optimization recs."

Risks / blockers:
- Billing export delayed (finance loop). Contingency: use Console usage summary for rough numbers.
- Customer hesitant on sharing sample payloads (privacy). Offer on-device scrubbing + NDA short clause.

Outcome targets for today:
- Confirm incident cause or escalate by EOD.
- Update renewal one-pager with baseline + 2 cost-saving levers.
- Send customer sample-request email (draft ready).

Misc scratch (brain dump):
- Metrics to highlight in QBR: p50/p95 latency, tokens/day, error rate, tail latency change week-over-week, 90-day trend vs SKU.
- Possible ask to product: point estimate on dedicated pool burst cost delta if we increase burst cap by 25%.
- Remind: include success story blurb about 2.1x throughput after quantization in similar customer case (internal PR: gh/infra/quant-ops-19).

End-of-day check (quick):
- [ ] SRE responded
- [ ] Billing numbers updated
- [ ] Renewal one-pager revised + versioned (attach to Confluence)
- [ ] Customer sample request sent

Next actions if time permits:
- Draft QBR slide deck skeleton (5 slides). Use template: confluence:templates/qbr-compact
- Pull any FYI notes from Solutions Eng: Owen said they ran a warm-standby test last month; follow up for test logs.

Notes to self: keep emails concise, data-driven. Prioritize clear asks (sample payloads + renewal timeline).
